capstmts.title: Medication REMS Capability Statement - Provider System
capstmts.security: 1. Communication security implemented by the Provider System SHALL conform with the guidelines stated in [FHIR Security](https://www.hl7.org/fhir/security.html) for all exchanges covered in this IG. 2. For general security considerations refer to [FHIR Security and Privacy Considerations](https://www.hl7.org/fhir/secpriv-module.html).
